message: The search completed within its budgets, but no train offers a multi-segment combination in which every segment explicitly reports confirmed availability. Per-train details and skip reasons are included; unverified segments are not treated as unavailable.

candidates.skip_detail: Train does not carry class SL (classes: 2S, CC).

errors.message: The provider could not answer this item.

notes: These results are point-in-time availability checks, not booked tickets. RailRoute AI does not book tickets.
Every segment of every returned combination explicitly reports confirmed availability (provider status AVAILABLE). RAC, waitlist, regret, unavailable, unknown and provider errors never qualify.

A combination of separately available segment tickets on one train is NOT an officially confirmed booking permission: Indian Railways ticketing rules for split journeys on the same train must be verified before relying on this.
Availability figures can be older than the check time (provider-side caching): each segment carries its provider last_updated_at and each combination reports the oldest one.
A provider error is never interpreted as unavailability; affected possibilities are reported as unverified.
Segment fares can exceed the direct through-route fare; every result includes a fare comparison when the direct fare is known.
